brief.topic: The Longer Journey That Makes a Basket Lighter

s01: A small pulley can make a hanging basket feel lighter to lift.
But it asks for a longer movement of the rope.
The rope passes underneath a wheel attached to the basket.
Two strands support the load, each carrying the same tension.
For an ideal, slow lift, each strand supplies half the basket weight.
Watch the basket rise one metre.
Both supporting strands lose one metre of length.
The free end must move two metres to take up that rope.
Half the force is traded for twice the distance.
Force times distance gives the work for a steady lift.
The energy needed to raise the basket has not disappeared.
We are ignoring friction, stretching, and the weight of the wheel.
Now start again and move the free end only one metre.
The basket rises just half a metre.
The geometry keeps the same bargain, even for a smaller lift.
A simple machine changes the way we supply the effort, while the lifted basket still gains energy.

scenes.narration:
A small pulley can make a hanging basket feel lighter to lift. But it asks for a longer movement of the rope.

One end is fixed above. The rope passes underneath a wheel attached to the basket. Two strands support the load, each carrying the same tension. For an ideal, slow lift, each strand supplies half the basket weight.

Watch the basket rise one metre. Both supporting strands lose one metre of length. The free end must move two metres to take up that rope. Half the force is traded for twice the distance.

Force times distance gives the work for a steady lift. The energy needed to raise the basket has not disappeared. We are ignoring friction, stretching, and the weight of the wheel.

Now start again and move the free end only one metre. The basket rises just half a metre. The geometry keeps the same bargain, even for a smaller lift. A simple machine changes the way we supply the effort, while the lifted basket still gains energy.
